sample_mapping_evidence: Two explicit additional patientsPt14/Pt15 in primaryPMID34807232 andGEO. UseonlyCD8PBL nativeRNArecords; matchedtumor, bulkvalidation andearlierdiscoverycohort notadditionalbloodsamples. SelectedCD8compartment preserved; no extra clinicalvisits inferred.

source_processing: The amplified cDNA from each channel of the Chromium System was used to construct an Illumina sequencing library and sequenced on a HiSeq 2500 with 150 cycle sequencing (asymmetric reads per 10x Genomics).
Illumina basecall files (*.bcl) were converted to FASTQs using CellRanger v3.1.0 (10X Genomics), which usesbcl2fastq v2.17.1.14for FASTQ files generation.
FASTQ files were aligned to GRCh38 human reference genome and transcriptome using the CellRanger v3.1.0 software pipeline with default parameters
UMIs were calculated by CellRanger v3.1.0

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Market Exchange Format (MEX) matrices (.mtx) containing the UMI counts for each cell;  TSV files (.tsv) with genes and barcode sequences corresponding to row and column indices of the MEX file, respectively

title: CD8PBL.Pt14
source_name_ch1: CD8 T cells from peripheral blood
extract_protocol_ch1: CD8+ T cells in peripheral blood lymphocytes and  tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes from 2 melanoma patients were isolated using fluorescence activated cell sorting (FACS). Further processing on sorted cells was conducted using  Chromium Single Cell 5' Gene Expression kit (10x Genomics).

Single-cell gel beads in emulsion (GEMs) macrophages were generated on a GemCode Single Cell Instrument (10x Genomics). Single-cell RNA-seq cDNA libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 5' Gene Expression (10x Genomics) according to manufacturer's protocol.
